memory.description: Memory allocation for the cluster, such as 0.5_gb, 1_gb, 2_gb, 4_gb, 8_gb, 16_gb, 32_gb, 64_gb, 96_gb, 128_gb, 192_gb, 256_gb, or 384_gb.

vcpu.description: vCPU configuration for the cluster, such as 2_vcpus_2_hr_burst_per_day or dedicated vCPU options.

gpu.description: Whether to provision a GPU-enabled cluster for embedding generation.

typesense_server_version.description: Typesense Server version to deploy on the cluster.

high_availability.description: Whether to enable high availability with 3-node replication.

search_delivery_network.description: Whether to enable search delivery network for global distribution.

regions.description: Cloud regions to deploy the cluster in.

cluster_name.description: Optional friendly name for the cluster.

auto_upgrade_capacity.description: Whether to automatically upgrade cluster capacity when needed.
